haki.evidence: Chapter 1110: on arriving at Egghead he imbues and hardens his sword with Armament Haki.
Chapter 1117: black lightning erupts from his clash with Zoro, the established sign of two Supreme King users colliding.
Chapter 1115: he senses the life signs inside Egghead's Labophase.

results.note: Corrected the scraped hints: Armament is visible at 1110 rather than 1117, and Observation is 1115 rather than null. His chapter 233 'debut' is an unnamed Elder silhouette. The black-lightning burst accompanying his 1110 arrival could be read as an earlier Conqueror hint, but it is only confirmed as such at the 1117 clash.

results.note: Observation is databook-only. Izou disarms King with one shot at 986, which is an arguable earlier Armament hint, but 992 is the first explicit Haki-imbued attack.

haki.evidence: Chapter 1152: Scopper Gaban reveals that Loki killed the immortal Harald with a Supreme King Haki-infused Ragnir.
Chapter 1179: he senses Imu's arrival on Elbaph and identifies the Haki as the same one from earlier.

results.note: Both scraped hints held up. The killing blow itself is only depicted later, in the chapter 1169-1170 flashback, so 1152 is where the reader first learns it. Loki also feels a distant Haki burst at 1151 and 1177, but the wiki attributes his Observation specifically to 1179.

results.note: Both scraped hints held up. Sanji's first confirmed on-panel Armament use is much later, chapter 833 against Judge, but the on-page statement at 668 is when the reader learns it.

haki.evidence: Vivre Card is the actual source; chapter 661 is the first on-page moment he reads Haki strength, warning Tashigi hers is too weak for Law.

results.note: Chapter 559 establishes that Smoker could not use Haki before the timeskip, so both types are post-timeskip. Observation is effectively databook-only; 661 is a weak anchor.

haki.evidence: Chapter 990: after turning on the Beasts Pirates he imbues his axes with Armament Haki to strike down the Number Juki.
Vivre Card #0515 only; dated to 990, the chapter where readers first see Drake confirmed as a Haki user.

results.note: The wiki also cites the chapter 725/727 cover story, where Drake wounds the Logia Caribou, as an indirect earlier hint at Armament Haki; it is too implicit for a reader to conclude from, so 990 is used.
